eng_text: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Gwiozdy ymitujōm światło i ciepło dziynki ynergije wytworzanyj w czasie łōnczynio sie atōmōw wodoru w ciynżyjsze elymynta.
eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Naukowce procujōm nad stworzyniym reaktora, kery mōgby wytworzać ynergijo w tyn sōm spōsōb.
eng_text: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Je to jednak fest ciynżki do rozwiōnzanio problym i minie jeszcze moc lot, podwiela doczekōmy sie budowy użytecznych reaktorōw termojōndrowych.
eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Stalowo jegła unosi sie na powiyrzchni wody dziynki napiynciu powiyrzchniowymu.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Napiyncie powierzchniowe wystympuje, pōniywoż czōnsteczki wody na powiyrzchni wody sōm fest prziciōngane do siebie, barzij aniżeli do czōnsteczek luftu bydōncych nad niymi.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Czōnsteczki wody tworzōm na jeji powiyrzchnie niywidzialno powłōka, kero pozwolo takim przedmiotōm jak jegła unosić sie na powiyrzchni wody.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Szpica w modernyj szlynzusze mo dwojisty rant z wklynsłym zogłymbiyniym pōmiyndzy. Dwa ranty przizwolajōm na lepsze trzimanie sie lodu, nawet przi przechyleniu.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Pōniywoż spodnio tajla szpice je leko zakrziwiono, kej szpica przechylo sie na jedna abo drugo strōna, rant, kery styka sie z lodym, tyż sie zakrzywio.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: To powoduje ôbrōt szlynzuchorza. Jeźli szlynzuchy skrziwiajōm sie w prawo, szlynzuchorz skrynco w prawo, jeźli szlynzuchy skrziwiajōm sie w lewo, szlynzuchorz skrynco w lewo.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Coby wrōcić sie do piyrwyjszego poziōmu ynergije, muszōm pozbyć sie ekstra ynergije, kero dostały ôd światła.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Robiōm to bez ymitowanie malućkich czōnsteczek światła zwanych "fotōnami".
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Uczōne nazywajōm tyn proces "stymulowanōm ymisyjōm prōmiyniowanio", pōniywoż atōmy sōm stymulowane bez jasne światło, kere powoduje ymisyjo fotōnu światła, a światło je zortōm prōmiyniowanio.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Dalszy ôbrozek przedstawio atōmy ymitujōnce fotōny. Toć w ryalności fotony sōm ô moc myńsze aniżeli te na zdjyńciu.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Fotōny sōm jeszcze myńsze jak elymynty, z kerych zbudowane sōm atōmy!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Po setkach godzin roboty żarnik we żarōwce w kōńcu sie przepolo i żarōwka ustowo fungować.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Wtynczos żarōwka wymogo wmiany. Przi wmianie żarōwki trza dować pozōr.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Nojprzōd noleży ôdłōnczyć kabel abo ôdetnōnć zasiylanie we ôprawie.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Dzieje sie tak, pōniywoż sztrōm płynōncy do ôprawy, w keryj wrażōno je metalowo tajla żarōwki, może sprawić powożne porażenie sztrōmym elektrycznym, jeźli tykniesz postrzodka ôprawy abo metalowyj podstawy żarōwki, kej je ôna durch czyńściowo we sztekdōuzie.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Głownym ôrganym układu krwiōnośnego je serce, kere plōmpie krew.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Krew wychodzi z serca przewodami zwanymi tyntnicami i wroco do serca przewodami zwanymi żyłami. Nojmyńsze kanaliki nazywane sōm noczyniami włosowatymi.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Zymby triceratopsa sōm w stanie zmiażdżyć niy ino listki, ale nawet fest twarde gałyńzie i korzynie.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Niykerzi uczyni uwożajōm, co Triceratops zjodoł cykady, czyli zorta rośliny, kero była powszechno we Kryjdzie.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Rośliny te wyglōndajōm jak mało palma z korōnōm ôstrych, szachlatych listkōw.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Triceratops mōg używać swojigo siylnego dziuba do srywanio listkōw przed zjedzyniym pnia.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Inksi uczyni twiyrdzōm, co te rośliny sōm fest trujōnce, tōż je mało prowdopodobne, co keryś dinozaur je jod, chocioż dzisiej lyniwiec i inksze zwiyrzynta, take jak papagaj (potōmek ôd dinozaurōw) mogōm jeść trujōnce listki abo ôwoce.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: W jaki spōsōb grawitacyjo Io wpływałaby na mie? Kebyś stanōł na powiyrzchni Io, wożōłbyś mynij aniżeli na Ziymi.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Ôsoba, kero woży 200 fōntōw (90kg) na Ziymi, na Io wożyłaby kole 36 fōntōw (16kg). Tak tōż grawitacyjo - co ôczywiste - mynij na ciebie działo.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Słōńce (inakszyj niż Ziymia) niy mo szkorupy, co na nij szłoby stanōńć. Cołke Słōńce je zbudowane z gazōw, ôgnia i plazmy.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: W miara ôddalanio sie ôd cyntrum Słōńca, gaz stowo sie coroz rzodszy.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Zewnyntrzno czynść, kero widzymy, jak zaglōndomy na Słōńce, mianuje sie fotosferōm, co ôznaczo "kula światła".
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Kole trzi tysiōnce lot niyskorzij, w 1610 roku, italijański astrōnōm Galileo Galilei użōł fernrora, coby zaôbserwować, co Wynus mo fazy, podobnie jak Miesiōnczek.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Fazy wystympujōm, pōniywoż ôświytlōno je ino ta strōna Wynus (abo Miesiōnczka), kero je swrōcōno we strōna Słōńca. Fazy Wynus potwiyrdzały teoryjo Kopernika, iże planety krōnżōm naôbkoło Słōńca.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Potym, pora lot niyskorzij, w 1639 roku, angelski astrōnōm Jeremiah Horrocks zaôbserwowoł tranzyt Wynus.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Anglijo doświadczōła dugigo ôkresu pokoju po ôdbiciu Danelawu.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Ale we 911 r. Etherled natrefiył flota wiynkszo jak ta ôd Guthruma storocze przōdzij.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Flota bōło dowodzōno bez Olafa Trygvassōna, Norwega ze ambicyjami, coby wyprowadzić swōj kraj spod duńskij dōminacyje.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Po poczōntkowych niypowodzyniach, Ethelred bōł skłōnny zgodzić sie na warunki ôd Olafa, kery wrōciōł nazod do Norwegije, coby zdobyć swoje krōlestwo (z rōztomajtym powodzyniym).
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul je jedynōm cylowo wymyślōnōm alfabetōm we powszechnym codziynnym użyciu. Alfabeta ta ôstała wynaleziōno w 1444 roku za panowanio krōla Sejonga (1418 - 1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Krōl Sejong bōł sztwortym krōlym dynastyje Joseon i je jednym z nojbarzij powożanych.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Przōdzij nazwoł ôn alfabeta Hangeul Hunmin Jeongeum, co ôznaczo "właściwe dźwiynki do nauczanio ludzi".
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Istnieje moc teoryje na tymat tego, jak powstoł sanskryt. Jedna z nich godo ô migracyji Aryjczyków ze zachodu do Indyjōw, kaj przinieśli ze sobōm swoja godka.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskryt je jynzykym antycznym i je porōwnowalny ze łacinōm używanōm we Europie.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Nojstarszo znano ksiōnżka na świecie była napisano w sanskrycie. Po skōmpilowaniu Upaniszad, sanskryt zaniknōł skirz hierarchije.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskryt je fest słożōnym i bogatym jynzykym, kery posużōł za zdrzōdło do mocy ôbecnych jynzykōw indyjskich, tak jak łacina je zdrzōdłym jynzykōw europejskich, takich jak francuski i hiszpański.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Po zakończyniu bitwy ô Francyjo, Niymcy zaczły rychtować sie do najozdu na wyspa Wielko Brytanijo.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Niymcy nadali tymu atakowi kryptonim "Ôperacyjo Sealion". Wiynkszość ciynżkij brōni i forantōw armije brytyjskij ôstała stracōno w czasie ewakuacyje z Dunkierki, tōż armijo była doś słabo.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Jednak Royal Navy durch była moc siylniyjszo ôd niymieckij mariny wojynnyj ("Kriegsmarine") i mogła zniszczyć kożdo flota inwazyjno wysłano bez kanał La Manche.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Jednak fest mało szifōw Royal Navy bazowało po blisku ôd prowdopodobnych sztrekōw najozdu, bo admiyroły bōły sie, co szify ôstanōm zatopione bez niymiecke fligry.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Trza zacznōnć ôd wyklarowanio planōw Italije. Italijo była przede wszyskim "modszym bratym" ôd Niymiec i Japōnije.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Miała słabszo armijo i słabszo flota, choć zaroz przed napoczyńciym wojny zbudowała sztyry nowe szify.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Głownym cylym Italije były kraje afrykańske. Coby zdobyć te kraje, Italijo musiałaby mieć baza wypadowo do wojsk, tak, coby mogły ône przepłynōnć bez Morze Śródziymne i napaś Afryka.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: W tym cylu przinoleżało pozbyć sie brytyjskich bazōw i szifōw we Egipcie. Poza tymi działaniami italijańske pancerniki niy miały robić nic wiyncyj.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Teroz ô Japōniji. Japōnijo była krajym wyspiorskim, tak jak Wielko Brytanijo.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Szify podwodne to szify zaprojektowane do poruszanio sie pod wodōm i ôstowanio tam bez dugszy czas.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Szify podwodne były używane w czasie I i II wojny światowyj. W tamtych czasach były ône fest powolne i miały barzo ôgraniczōny zasiyng ôgnia.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Na zaczōntku wojny szify podwodne poruszały sie z wiynksza na powiyrzchni morza, ale społym z rozwojym radaru i wzrōstym jego akuratności, były zmuszōne schodzić pod woda, coby uniknōńć wykrycio.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Niymiecke szify podwodne były nazywane U-Bootami. Niymce byli fest dobre we nawigacyji i ôperowaniu swojimi szifami podwodnymi.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Skuli swojich sukcesōw z podwodnymi szifami Niymcy po wojnie niy mieli tela zaufanio, coby dać im mieć moc takich szifōw.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Ja! Krōl Tutanchamon, czasami nazywany "Krōlym Tutym" abo "Krōlym Synkym", je jednym z nojbarzij znanych w czasach teroźnych antycznych krōlōw egipskich.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Co ciekawe, niy bōł ôn uwożany za fest ważnego w czasach antycznych i niy ôstoł ôdnotowany na wiynkszości antycznych wykozōw krōlōw.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Jednak ôdkrycie jego grobu w 1922 roku zrobiōło z niego celebryty. W czasie kej moc grobōw z przeszłości ôstało ôgrabionych, tyn grōb ôstoł praktycznie niyruszōny.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Wiynkszość przedmiotōw pochowanych ze Tutanchamonem zachowała sie w dobrym stanie, w tym tysiōnce artefaktōw wykōnanych ze szlachetnych metalōw i rzodkich kamyni.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Wynalazek kōł szprychowych sprawiōł, co asyryjske rydwany stały sie leksze, gibsze i lepij narychtowane do wyprzedzanio wojokōw i inkszych rydwanōw.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Szusy z jejich śmiyrciōnośnych kuszōw mogły przebić zbroja wojokōw ôd rywala. Kole 1000 r. p.n.e. Asyryjczyki wkludziyli piyrszo kawaleryjo.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Kawaleryjo to armijo, kero bije sie na kōniach. Siodła jeszcze niy wynojdli, tōż asyryjsko kawaleryjo biyła sie na nagich grzbietach ôd swojich kōni.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Znōmy moc greckich politykrōw, uczōnych i artystōw. Prowdopodobnie nojbarzij znanōm postaciōm tyj kultury je Homer, legyndarny niywidōmy poeta, kery stworzōł dwa arcydzieła literatury greckij: poymaty Iliada i Ôdyseja.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sofokles i Arystofanes durch sōm popularnymi dramatopisarzami, a jejich sztuki zaliczane sōm do nojsrogszych dzieł literatury światowyj.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Inkszym znōcznym Grekiym je matymatyk Pitagoras, kery głōwnie wsławiōł sie swojim twiyrdzyniym ô zwiōnzkach bokōw trzikōntōw prostokōntnych.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Istniejōm roztōmajte szacōnki, kere tyczōm sie liczby ôsōb posugujōncych sie jynzykym hindi. Szacuje sie, co je ôn miyndzy drugim a sztwortym nojczyńścij używanym jynzykym na świecie.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Liczba rodzimych używoczōw godki zmiynio sie w znoleżności ôd tego, eli wrachowowane sōm fest blisko spokrewniōne dialekty, eli tyż niy.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Szacuje sie, co jynzykym tym posuguje sie ôd 340 mln do 500 mln ôsōb, a spokopić poradzi go aż 800 mln ludzi.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi i Urdu sōm podobne we słownictwie, ale rōżniōm sie pismem; we codziynnych ôsprowkach używocze ôbōch jynzykōw zwykle mogōm sie zrozumieć.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Kole XV stolecio pōłnocno Estōnijo była pod wielkim kulturowym wpływym Niymiec.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Niykere niymiecke mnichy chcieli przibliżyć Boga tubylcōm, bez co wymyślyli estōński literacki jynzyk.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Oparty bōł na alfabecie niymieckim z dodanym jednym znakym "o/o".
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Z upływym czasu, moc słōw, kere ôstały zapożyczōne z jynzyka niymieckigo, zloło sie z jynzykym. To bōł poczōntek ôświycynio.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Tradycyjnie nastympca trōnu po ukōńczyniu szkoły szoł prosto do wojska.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Jednak Charles poszoł na uniwerzytet w Trinity College w Cambridge, kaj sztudiowoł antropologijo i archeologijo, a niyskorzij tyż historyjo, i uzyskoł 2:2 (stopiyń niższy drugij klasy).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles bōł piyrszym czōnkym brytyjskij familije krōlewskij, kery dostoł tytuł naukowy.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turcyjo europejsko (wschodnio Tracyjo abo Rumelijo na Pōłwyspie Bałkańskim) ôbyjmuje 3% powiyrzchnie kraju.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Terytorium Turcyje mo bez 1600 km (1000 mil) dugości i 800 km (500 mil) szyrokości, a jego kształt je zbliżōny do prostokōntu.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Powiyrzchnia Turcyje społym z jeziorami zajmuje 783 562 km2 (300 948 m2), z czego 755 688 km2 (291 773 m2) je w połedniowo-zachodnij Azyje, a 23 764 km2 (9 174 m2) we Europie.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Turcyjo zajmuje 37. plac na świecie pod wzglyndym srogości, a jij powiyrzchnia je rōwno powiyrzchni Francyje i Wielkij Brytanije razym wziyntych.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turcyjo je ôbtoczōno morzami z trzech strōn: Morzym Egejskim ôd zachodu, Morzym Czornym ôd pōłnocy i Morzym Strzōdziymnym ôd połednio.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luksymburg mo dugo historyjo, ale jego niypodległość datuje sie ôd 1839 roku.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Dzisiyjsze tajle Belgije były w przeszłości tajlōm Luksymburga, ale stały sie belgijske po rewolucyji belgijskij w 1830 roku.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luksymburg dycki staroł sie ôstać krajym neutralnym, ale bōł ôkupowany bez Niymcy tak w czasie I, jak i II wojny światowyj.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: W 1957 roku Luksymburg ôstoł czōnkym założycielym ôrganizacyje, kero dzisiej znano je jako Unijo Europejsko.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong to zrujnowany festōng i klosztōr buddyjski w wiyrchnij tajli dystryktu Poro (we wiosce Phondey).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Godo sie, co w 1649 roku Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel stworzōł festōng, coby upamiyntnić swoje zwyciynstwo nad siyłami tybetańsko-mōngolskimi.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Ôgyń w 1951 roku sprawiōł, co przetrwały ino niykere relikty Drukgyal Dzong, take jak ôbroz ôd Szabdrunga Ngawang Namgyala.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Po ôgniu festōng ôstoł zachowany i zabezpieczōny, beztōż ôstowo jednōm z nojbarzij wyjōntkowych aktrakcyjōw Bhutanu.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: W XVIII stolecio Kambodża znodła sie pōmiyndzy dwōma potynżnymi sōmsiadami, Tajlandyjōm i Wietnamym.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Tajowie porakrotnie najeżdżali Kambodża w XVIII stoleciu, a we 1772 roku zniszczyli Phnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: W ôstatnich latach XVIII stolecio Wietnamczyki tyż najechali Kambodża.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Ôziymnoście procynt Wenezuelczyków je bezrobotnych, a wiynkszość z tych, kerzi sōm zatrudniyni, robi na czorno.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Dwie trzicie robiōncych Wenezuelczyków robi w sektorze usug, bezma jedna sztworto w industryji, a jedna piōnto w bauerstwie.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Ważnym produktym do Wenezuelczykōw je ropa naftowo, keryj kraj je eksporterym netto, chocioż ino jedyn procynt ludzi robi we industryji naftowyj.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Już na poczōntku niypodległości kraju, wiedza i doświadczynie Singapurskij Zygrody Botanicznyj pōmōgły przekształcić wyspa w tropikalne miasto-zygroda.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: W 1981 roku Vanda Miss Joaquim, hybryda ôd ôrchidei, ôstała ôbrano za kwiotek norodowy.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Coby przetrwać dyszcze, kożdego roku kole paździyrnika bezma 1,5 milijōna roślinożercōw wandruje z pōłnocnych bergōw w kerōnku połedniowych rōwniōw, przekroczajōnc przi tym rzyka Mora.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: A potym nazod na pōłnoc bez zachōd, zaś przekroczajōnc rzyka Mora, już po dyszczach, w ôkolicach kwietnia.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Regiōn Serengeti ôbyjmuje Park Norodowy Serengeti, Ôbszar Ôchrōny Ngorongoro i Rezerwat Maswa Game we Tanzaniji, jak tyż Park Norodowy Maasai Mora we Kyniji.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Nauka tworzynio mediōw interaktywnych wymogo umiyjyntności kōnwyncjōnalnych i tradycyjnych, ale tyż norzyndzi ôpanowanych na zajyńciach interaktywnych (storyboarding, mōntaż audio i wideo, ôsprawianie historyjōw itp.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Projektowanie interaktywne wymogo pōnownyj ôcyny założyń tyczōncych sie produkcyje mediōw i nauczynio sie myślynio we spusōb niylinijowy.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Interaktywny projekt wymogo, coby elymynta projektu łōnczyły sie ze sobōm, ale tyż miały syns jako ôsobne cołkości.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Felerym ôbiektywōw zmiynnoôgniskowych je to, co złożōność ôgniskowyj i liczba elymyntōw ôbiektywu wymoganych do ôsiōgniyncio zakresu ôgniskowych je znacznie srogszo aniżeli w przipadku ôbiektywōw stałoôgniskowych.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Problym tyn stowo sie coroz mynij istotny, pōniywoż producynty ôbiektywōw ôsiōngajōm coroz wyższe sztandardy w jejich produkcyji.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Pozwolyło to ôbiektywōm zmiynnoôgniskowym na wykōnowanie zdjyńć ô jakości porōwnowalnyj z jakościōm uzyskowanōm bez ôbiektywy ô stałyj ôgniskowyj.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Nostympny feler ôbiektywōw zmiynnoôgniskowych je taki, co maksymalny ôtwōr przisłōny (wartkość) ôbiektywu je zwykle myńszy.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Sprawio to, co niydrogie ôbiektywy zmiennoogniskowe sōm ciynżke do użycio bez lampy błyskowyj we warōnkach słabego ôświytlynio.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Jednym ze nojczynstszych problymōw przi kōnwertowaniu filmu do formatu DVD je nadbytek ôbrozu.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Wiynkszość telewizyjōw je robiōno we taki sposōb, coby ukōntyntować ôgōlno publika.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Skuli tego, wszyjsko, co widzisz we TV mo przistrzigniynte ranty z wiyrchu, ze spodka i ôd bokōw.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Je to robiōne, coby być zicher, co ôbroz zakryje cołki ekran. Mianuje sie to nadmiarowiściōm ôbrozu.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Niystety, kej robisz DVD, jego ranty też nojpewnij bydōm przistrzigniynte, i jak wideo mo napisy blisko dołu, to niy bydōm ône w pōłni pokozane.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Tradycyjny strzedniowieczny zōmek dugo inspirowoł wyłobraźnia, prziwodzōnc na myśl pojedynki, bankety i arturiaństo kawaleryjo.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Nawet kej sie stoji postrzōd tysiōncletnich ruin, idzie łatwo sie wyłobrazić źwiynki i wōnianie downych bitwōw, prawie usłyszeć stuk kopyt na bruku i poczuć bōnie, kere unosi sie z lochōw.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Ale czy nasza wyôbraźnia je zbudowano na rzeczywistości? Czymu zōmki bōły budowane za piyrsze? Jak bōły projektowane i budowane?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Typowy do tego ôkresu zōmek Kirby Muxloe je radszyj warownym dōmym aniżeli prowdziwym zōmkym.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Jego sroge przeszklōne ôkna i ciynke ściany niy poradziyłyby dugo strzimać poważnego ataku.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: W latach 80-tych XIV stolecio, kedy jego budowa napoczōn Lord Hastings, w kraju panowoł wzglyndny pokōj, a ôbrōna była kōnieczno ino przed małymi halastrami smykajōncych sie rojbrōw.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Rōwnowoga siył była systymym, w kerym norody europejske dōnżyły do utrzimania suwerynności norodowyj wszyjskich państw europejskich.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Kōncepcyjo ta zakłodała, co wszyjske norody europejske muszōm dōnżyć do tego, coby jedyn norōd niy stoł sie potynżny, bez to rzōndy norodowe czynsto zmiyniały swoje sojusze, coby utrzimać rōwnowoga.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Wojna ô sukcesyjo hiszpańsko była piyrszōm wojnōm, keryj głownym problymym była rōwnowoga siył.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Ôznaczało to ważno zmiana, pōniywoż mocarstwa europejske niy miały już pretekstu do kludzynio wojyn religijnych. Tym samym wojna trzidziestoletnio była ôstatniōm wojnōm, kero ôkryślano była mianym wojny religijnyj.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Świōntynia Artemidy w Efezie ôstała zniszczōno 21 lipnia 356 r. p.n.e. w wyniku podpolynio dokōnanego bez Herostratusa.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Podle ôzprowki, jego motywacyjōm była sława za wszelko cyna. Efezjany, zgorszōne, ôznajmiyli, iże miano Herostratusa nigdy niy ôstanie zapisane.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Grecki historyk Strabo spisoł niyskorzij miano, kero znōmy dzisiej. Świōntynia ôstała zniszczōno tyj samyj nocy, kedy narodziōł sie Aleksander Wielki.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Aleksander, jako krōl, zaôferowoł, co zapłaci za ôdbudowa świōntynie, ale jego ôferta ôdciepli. Niyskorzij, jak umar, świōntynia ôstała ôdbudowano we 323 r. p.n.e.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Ôbadej eli twoja rynka je tak rozluźniono, jak to możliwe, we tym samym czasie sprownie trzaskej we wszyjske knefle – starej sie tyż niy wykōnować za wiela podarymnych ruchōw palcami.
eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: W tyn spusōb jak nojmynij sie zmynczysz. Pamiyntej, iże niy ma potrzeby naciskanio knefli z srogōm siyłōm, coby dostać ekstra głośność, jak na klawiyrze.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Na cyji, coby dostać ekstra głośność, używosz miecha z srogszōm siyłōm abo wartkościōm.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Mistycyzm je dōnżyniym do świadōmości, jedności abo tożsamości z ôstatecznōm rzeczywistościōm, boskościōm, duchowōm prowdōm abo z Bogiym.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Wyznowca poszukuje bezpostrzednigo doświadczenio, intuicyje abo wglōndu w bosko rzeczywistość/bōstwo abo bōstwa.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Wyznowcy ryalizujōm pewne spōsoby życia abo praktyki, kere majōm na cylu pielyngnowanie tych doświadczyń.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Mistycyzm idzie ôdrōżnić ôd inkszych form wierzyń i kultōw religijnych bez nacisk na bezpostrzednie, ôsobiste doświadczynie wyjōntkowego stanu świadōmości, ôsobliwie ô karakterze spokojnym, wnikliwym, błogim, a nawet ekstatycznym.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhizm je religijōm, kero pochodzi ze subkontynentu indyjskigo. Powstoł w regiōnie Pendżabu w XV stoleciu z sekciarskigo rozłamu we ôbrymbie tradycyje hinduistycznyj.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Sikhowie uwożajōm swoja wiara za religijo ôsobno ôd hinduizmu, choć uznajōm jij hinduske korzynie i tradycyje.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Sikhowie nazywajōm swoja religijo Gurmat, co w jynzyku pendżabskim ôznaczo "drōga guru". Guru je fundamyntalnym aspektym wszyjskich indyjskich religiji, ale w sikhiźmie nabroł znaczynio, kere stanowi drzyń sikhijskich wierzyń.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Religijo ta ôstała założōno w XV stolecio bez Guru Nanaka (1469-1539). Pō nim prziszło dziewiyńciu dalszych guru.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Jednak w czyrwniu 1956 r. ôbiecki Chruszczowa ôstały wystawiōne na prōba, kej zaczły sie zamiyszki we Polsce, kaj robotniki protestowali przeciwko brakōm pożywiynio i tniyciu geltagu, przerodziły sie w powszechny protest przeciwko kōmunizmowi.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Chocioż w kōńcu Chruszczow wysłoł tanki, coby prziwrōcić porzōndek, to jednak ustōmpiōł przed niykerymi żōndaniami ekōnōmicznymi i zgodziōł sie mianować popularnego Władysława Gomułki nowym prymierym.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Cywilizacyjo doliny Indusu była cywilizacyjōm epoki brōnzu na pōłnocno-zachodnim subkontynencie indyjskim, ôbyjmujōncym wiynkszość teroźnego Pakistanu i niykere regiōny w pōłnocno-zachodnich Indyjach i pōłnocno-wschodnim Afganistanie.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Cywilizacyjo rozkwitła w dorzeczu ôd rzyki Indus, stōnd tyż wywodzi swoje miano.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Chocioż niykerzi naukowcy spekulujōm, co jako że cywilizacyjo istniała tyż w dorzeczu wyschniyntyj rzyki Sarasvati, winna być ôna właściwie nazwano Cywilizacyjōm Indusu-Sarasvati, w czasie zaś kej niykerzi nazywajōm ja Cywilizacyjōm Harappan skuli Happary, piyrszego miyjsca wykopalisk w latach 20-tych XX stolecio.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Militarystyczno natura ôd imperium rzimskigo prziczyniyła sie do rozwoju medycyny.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Dochtorōw zaczōn rekrutować cysorz August, kery utworzōł nawet piyrszy rzimski korpus medyczny do użycio po bitwach.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Chirurgi mieli wiedza na tymat roztōmajtych postrzodkōw uspokajajōncych, w tym morfiny z ekstraktōw z maku i skopolaminy z nasiyni lulka czornego.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Stali sie biegli we amputacyji, coby uretować pacjyntōw przed gangrynōm, jak tyż w stosowaniu ôposek uciskowych i zaciskōw tyntniczych, coby zasztopować przepływ krwie.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Bez moc stoleci imperium rzimske dokludziyło do wielkich ôsiōngniyńć w dziedzinie medycyny i ukształtowało moc z wiedze, kero znōmy dzisiej.
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: "Pureland ôrigami" to origami z ôgraniczyniym, co idzie wykōnać ino jedno zagiyncie na roz, barzij słożōne zagiyncia, take jak zagiyncie na ôpy, sōm niyprzizwolōne, a wszyjske zagiyncia majōm proste lokalizacyje.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Ôstało ôno ôpracowane bez Johna Smitha w latach 70-tych, coby pōmōc niydoświadczōnym ôrigamiorzōm abo ôsobōm ô ôgraniczōnych talyntach motorycznych.
eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Dziycia doś wczas rozwijajōm świadōmość rasy i stereotypōw rasowych, a te stereotypy rasowe wpływajōm na zachowanie.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Bez przikłod dziycia, kere idyntyfikujōm sie z myńszościōm rasowōm, kero je stereotypowo widziano za tako, kero niy radzi sie we szkole, zwykle niy radzōm sie dobrze we szkole, po tym, jak już poznajōm stereotyp zwiōnzany z jejich rasōm.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace je trzeciōm nojpopularniyjszōm zajtōm we Stanach Zjednoczōnych i mo terozki 54 miliōny profilōw.
eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Te zajty internerowe sebrały moc uwogi, a już wcale we edukacyji.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Wjozd autym do Afryki Połedniowyj je niyôbyczajnym spōsobym na ôboczynie cołkigo piykna ôd tego regiōnu, jak tyż na dotarcie do placōw poza normalnymi sztrekami turystycznymi.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls to miasto w zachodnij tajli Zimbabwe, po drugij strōnie granice z Livingstone w Zambiji i blisko Botswany.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Miasto leży bezpostrzednio przi wodopadach i to ône sōm głownōm atrakcyjōm, ale tyn popularny plac turystyczny ôferuje moc możliwości na dugszy pobyt tak poszukowoczōm przigod, jak i zwiydzajōncym.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: W porze deszczowyj (ôd listopada do marca), ôbjyntość wody bydzie srogszo, a wodopod barzij dramatyczny.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Grobowiec ôd Tutanchamōna (KV62). KV62 prowdopodobnie je nojsłynniyjszy z grobowcōw we Dolinie, plac ôdkrycio bez Howarda Cartera w 1922 roku bezma niyruszōnego krōlewskigo pochōwku ôd modego krōla.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: W przirōwnaniu z wiynkszościōm inkszych krōlewskich grobowcōw, grobowiec ôd Tutanchamōna je jednak ledwo wert nawiydzynio, jako moc myńszy i z ôgraniczōnōm wielościōm dekoracyji.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Kożdy, fto by chcioł ôboczyć ślady zniszczyń mumije dokōnanych w czasie prōb wyjmniyńcio jij z trōły, bydzie utropiōny, bo widzialne sōm jyno gowa i ramiōna.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Turysty z ôgraniczōnōm wielościōm czasu winni spyńdzić go kaj indzij.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km na połedniowy zachōd ôd Siem Reap. Ta położōno na bergu świōntynia była zbudowano pod kōniec IX stolecio, za panowanio krōla Yasovarmana.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Jerozolima je głownym miastym i nojsrogszym miastym Izraela, choć wiynkszość inkszych krajōw jak tyż Ôrganizacyjo Norodōw Zjednoczōnych niy uznajōm jij za głowne miasto Izraela.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Skuli religijnego znaczynio miasta, a w ôsobliwości mocy placōw w przestrzyństwie Starego Miasta, Jerozolima je jednym z głownych ôstrzodkōw turystycznych w Izraelu.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerozolima mo moc historycznych, archeologicznych i kulturalnych placōw, społym z tyntniōncymi życiym i zaciźbiōnymi cyntrami handlowymi, kafyjami i restauracyjami.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ekwadōr wymogo ôd ôbywatelōw kubańskich dostanio zaproszynio przed wjazdym do Ekwadoru bez miyndzynorodowe porty lotnicze abo pōnkty graniczne.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Ausflugi sōm tōńsze dlo srogszych grup, tōż jeźli je żeś sōm abo ino z jednym kamratym, sprōbuj poznać inkszych ludzi i utworzić grupa ôd sztyrech do sześciu ôsōb, coby dostać lepszo cyna za ôsoba.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Nad pōłnocnym krajym Machu Picchu gōruje ta strōmo gōra, co je czynsto zadkym dlo mocy fotografiji rujin.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Przed przibyciym Hiszpanōw w 16 stoleciu, pōłnocne Chile było pod panowaniym Inkōw, w czasie kej drzynni Araukanie (Mapuche) zamiyszkowali postrzodkowe i połedniowe Chile.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Choć Chile roznajmiyło niyzawisłość w 1810 r. (w czasie wojyn napoleōńskich, co sprawiyły, iże Hiszpanijo na pora lot pozbyto była funkcjōniyrujōncego regyrōnku cyntralnego), decydujōnce zwyciynstwo nad Hiszpanami ôdniosło dopiyro w 1818 r.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Ôkrōm sztrandōw ze biołym pioskym i gōrskimi landszaftami we kraju leży nojstarsze europejske miasto we Ameryce, teroz tajla Santo Dōmingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bowen Island je popularnōm jednodniowōm abo weekendowōm destynacyjōm ausflugowōm ôferujōncōm spływy kajakowe, wandry, sklepy, restauracyje i moc wiyncyj.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Ta autyntyczno społeczność je w Howe Sound zaroz kole Vancouver i je snadnie przistympno dziynki regularnym taksōwkōm wodnym ôdpływajōncym z Granville Island w cyntrum Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Dlo tych, co radzi spyndzajōm czas na świyżym lufcie, kōnieczny je wander chodźbōm Sea to Sky.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Zwōle muszōm być zarezerwowane z wyprzedzyniym. Musisz mieć zwōlo na noclyg w Sirynie.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Zwōl na pobyt w parku idzie dostać bezpostrzednio w Ranger Station w Puerto Jiménez, ale ôni niy przijmujōm kart kredytowych.

eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Wyspy Cooka to państwo wyspiorske we swobodnym zwiōnzku z Nowōm Zelandyjōm, położōne w Polinezyji, w postrzodkowyj tajli połedniowego Ôceanu Spokojnego.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Ze tōm samōm strefōm czasowōm co Hawaje, te wyspy sōm niyroz ôkryślane za "Hawaje na spodku".
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: W krajach rozwiniyntych w dzisiyjszych czasach ôferowanie luksusowych łōżek i śniodań ôstało dźwigniynte do gradusa kōnsztu.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Na nojwyższym poziōmie, B&B snadnōm rzeczōm kōnkurujōm ze sobōm z wiynksza w dwōch kwestyjach: łōżka i śniodanio.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Bez to w nojlepszych takich placōwkach idzie znojś nojbarzij luksusowe łōżka, możno ryncznie robiōno sztepdeka abo zabytkowe łōżko.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Śniodanie może ôbyjmować sezōnowe maszkety z regiōnu abo specjalność ôd gospodorza.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Może to być stary, zabytkowy budōnek z antycznymi meblami, wypielyngnowanym terynym i basynym.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Siodanie do włosnego auta i wyruszanie w dugo rajza mo swōj urok we swojij prostocie.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: W ôpaczności do srogszych wozideł, prowdopodobnie je żeś już zaznajōmiōny z kludzyniym swojigo auta i znosz jego ôgraniczynia.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Rozstawiynie celtu na prywatnyj posesyji abo w mieście leda jakij srogości może snadnie prziciōngnōńć niypożōndano uwoga.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: We skrōcie, używanie auta to szumny spusōb na ausflug, ale rzodko kedy je to spusōb na "biwakowanie".
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Kymping autowy je możliwy, jeźli mosz srogigo minivana, SUV-a, sedana abo kōmbi z rozkłodanymi siedzyniami.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Niykere hotele majōm swoja erbizna ze złotyj ery ban parowych i szifōw ôceanicznych; przed II wojnōm światowōm, w XIX abo na zaczōntku XX stolecio.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.
